name: Diagnóstico I2C
description: Escanea el bus I2C e imprime qué sensores responden, o comprueba si hay algo en una dirección antes de arrancar. Arduino y MicroPython.

en.Escanea el bus I2C e imprime qué sensore: Scans the I2C bus and prints which sensors answer, or checks whether something is at an address before starting. Arduino and MicroPython.
